---
title: "FRAP Data Analysis - Multiple Regions per File"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
```

This version handles csv files where each file contains **multiple regions
of interest**: columns named `Mean(targeted_1)`, `Mean(targeted_2)`, ...,
`Mean(untargeted_1)`, `Mean(untargeted_2)`, ..., all sharing a single
`Mean(background)` column. Each `targeted_x` region is paired with the
`untargeted_x` region that shares the same number `x`. Everything else
(time conversion, background subtraction, pre-bleach normalization,
targeted/untargeted ratio, cell line grouping) works exactly as in the
single-region version — it's just applied per region instead of per file.

## Parameters

```{r params}
data_folder <- "/Volumes/lionnt01lab/lionnt01labspace/Henry/FRAP/2026_07_20_quick_recovery_replicate_1"
# --- channel identity ---
# Name what was measured in each channel. Odd rows in the csv = channel_1,
# even rows = channel_2. If you only measured a single channel, set
# channel_2 <- NA and every row will be treated as channel_1 instead of
# being split into odd/even rows.
channel_1 <- "GFP"
channel_2 <- "Halo-JFx650"   # set to NA for single-channel data

# --- acquisition timing (per channel) ---
n_pre         <- 5     # number of frames pre-bleach
interval_pre  <- 0.2   # seconds between pre-bleach frames

n_post1        <- 25   # number of frames in post-bleach phase 1
interval_post1 <- 0.2 # seconds between frames in post-bleach phase 1

n_post2        <- 26   # number of frames in post-bleach phase 2
interval_post2 <- 1.0  # seconds between frames in post-bleach phase 2

n_post3        <- 16    # number of frames in post-bleach phase 3
interval_post3 <- 2.0  # seconds between frames in post-bleach phase 3

# time (s) of the bleach event, measured from the start of acquisition
# (i.e. the time of the last pre-bleach frame). Used internally to shift
# all times so that the bleach event itself is t = 0: pre-bleach frames
# get negative times, post-bleach frames get positive times.
bleach_time_raw <- (n_pre - 1) * interval_pre + interval_post1

# max number of panels per row in the "per region" grid plots
max_panels_per_row <- 10

# --- export settings (for comparing replicates later) ---
# a short label identifying this experiment/replicate, e.g. "replicate_1".
# Used to tag exported curves so they can be told apart when combined with
# other replicates in the comparison script.
replicate_label <- "replicate_1"

# folder where the exported average-curve csv files will be saved
# (created automatically if it doesn't exist)
export_folder <- file.path(data_folder, "exported_curves")

```

## List CSV files

```{r list-files}
csv_files <- list.files(data_folder, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
csv_files
```

## Helper: convert frame number to time

Time is expressed relative to the bleach event: the last pre-bleach frame
(and everything after it) is shifted so that frame lands at, or after,
`t = 0`. Pre-bleach frames therefore get negative times, and post-bleach
frames get positive times.

```{r frame-to-time}
n_total_expected <- n_pre + n_post1 + n_post2 + n_post3

frame_to_time <- function(frame) {
  intervals <- c(
    rep(interval_pre,   max(n_pre - 1, 0)),
    rep(interval_post1, n_post1),
    rep(interval_post2, n_post2),
    rep(interval_post3, n_post3)
  )
  times <- c(0, cumsum(intervals))
  # shift so the bleach event (end of the pre-bleach phase) is t = 0
  times[frame] - bleach_time_raw
}

# the bleach event is now t = 0 by construction (kept as `bleach_time` so
# the reference line drawn on the plots below still works unchanged)
bleach_time <- 0
```

## Read and reshape

For each file, we:

1. Assign `channel`, `frame`, `time`, and `cell_line` exactly as before (row
   parity for two channels, or every row for a single channel; `cell_line`
   is everything before the first `_` in the file name).
2. Reshape the wide `Mean(targeted_x)` / `Mean(untargeted_x)` columns into
   long format, extracting the region number `x` from the column name.
3. Join the `targeted` and `untargeted` values back together by region
   number, so each row is one region, at one frame, in one file/channel —
   identified by `roi_id`.

If a file has a `targeted_x` region with no matching `untargeted_x` (or
vice versa), that region is kept with `NA` for the missing side and a
warning is printed — it will simply be excluded from ratio plots.

```{r read-data}
read_frap_file <- function(path) {
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df <- df %>% select(-1) %>% rename(background = `Mean(background)`)

  if (is.na(channel_2)) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        channel   = channel_1,
        file      = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
        cell_line = sub("_.*", "", file),
        frame     = row_number()
      )
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        row_id    = row_number(),
        channel   = if_else(row_id %% 2 == 1, channel_1, channel_2),
        file      = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
        cell_line = sub("_.*", "", file)
      ) %>%
      group_by(channel) %>%
      mutate(frame = row_number()) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(-row_id)
  }

  n_frames_per_channel <- max(df$frame)
  if (n_frames_per_channel != n_total_expected) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "%s: found %d frames per channel, but n_pre + n_post1 + n_post2 + n_post3 = %d. Check your parameters.",
      basename(path), n_frames_per_channel, n_total_expected
    ))
  }

  df <- df %>% mutate(time = frame_to_time(frame))

  # reshape targeted_x columns to long
  targeted_long <- df %>%
    select(file, cell_line, channel, frame, time, background,
           matches("^Mean\\(targeted_[0-9]+\\)$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols          = matches("^Mean\\(targeted_[0-9]+\\)$"),
      names_to      = "region",
      names_pattern = "Mean\\(targeted_([0-9]+)\\)",
      values_to     = "targeted"
    ) %>%
    mutate(region = as.integer(region))

  # reshape untargeted_x columns to long
  untargeted_long <- df %>%
    select(file, cell_line, channel, frame, time, background,
           matches("^Mean\\(untargeted_[0-9]+\\)$")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols          = matches("^Mean\\(untargeted_[0-9]+\\)$"),
      names_to      = "region",
      names_pattern = "Mean\\(untargeted_([0-9]+)\\)",
      values_to     = "untargeted"
    ) %>%
    mutate(region = as.integer(region))

  # pair them up by region number
  roi_long <- full_join(
    targeted_long, untargeted_long,
    by = c("file", "cell_line", "channel", "frame", "time", "background", "region")
  )

  unmatched <- roi_long %>%
    filter(is.na(targeted) | is.na(untargeted)) %>%
    pull(region) %>%
    unique()

  if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
    warning(sprintf(
      "%s: region(s) %s have only targeted or only untargeted data (no matching pair). These will be NA in ratio plots.",
      basename(path), paste(sort(unmatched), collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  roi_long <- roi_long %>%
    mutate(
      roi_id    = paste(file, channel, paste0("region", region), sep = " | "),
      roi_label = paste0(file, " - region ", region)
    )

  roi_long
}

frap_data <- csv_files %>%
  map_dfr(read_frap_file)

head(frap_data)
```

## Background subtraction

Computed here (right after reading the data) so both raw and
background-subtracted intensities can be plotted together below.

```{r background-subtraction}
frap_data <- frap_data %>%
  mutate(
    targeted_bgsub   = targeted   - background,
    untargeted_bgsub = untargeted - background
  )
```

## Raw and background-subtracted intensity plots (per region)

One row per region, with 4 panels per row: raw signal in `channel_1`,
background-subtracted signal in `channel_1`, raw signal in `channel_2`,
background-subtracted signal in `channel_2` (only 2 panels per row if
`channel_2` is `NA`). Each panel has its own independent y-scale.

```{r raw-bgsub-long-format}
plot_type_levels <- c("Raw", "Background-subtracted")
channels_present  <- if (is.na(channel_2)) channel_1 else c(channel_1, channel_2)
panel_levels <- unlist(lapply(channels_present, function(ch) paste(ch, plot_type_levels)))

raw_long <- frap_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(background, targeted, untargeted),
    names_to  = "measurement",
    values_to = "intensity"
  ) %>%
  mutate(plot_type = "Raw")

bgsub_long <- frap_data %>%
  select(roi_label, channel, frame, time, targeted_bgsub, untargeted_bgsub) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(targeted_bgsub, untargeted_bgsub),
    names_to  = "measurement",
    values_to = "intensity"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measurement = recode(measurement,
                          targeted_bgsub   = "targeted",
                          untargeted_bgsub = "untargeted"),
    plot_type = "Background-subtracted"
  )

frap_long_raw_bgsub <- bind_rows(raw_long, bgsub_long) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(paste(channel, plot_type), levels = panel_levels))

n_rows <- n_distinct(frap_long_raw_bgsub$roi_label)
```

```{r plot-raw-bgsub, fig.width=16, fig.height=pmax(8, 3 * n_rows)}
frap_long_raw_bgsub %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = intensity, color = measurement)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bleach_time, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ roi_label + panel, ncol = length(panel_levels), scales = "free") +
  labs(
    title = "Raw and background-subtracted intensities (per region)",
    x = "Time (s)", y = "Intensity", color = "Measurement"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Normalize to average pre-bleach intensity

Normalization is done per region (`roi_id`), i.e. per file, channel, and
region number.

```{r normalize-prebleach}
frap_data <- frap_data %>%
  group_by(roi_id) %>%
  mutate(
    targeted_pre_mean   = mean(targeted_bgsub[frame <= n_pre],   na.rm = TRUE),
    untargeted_pre_mean = mean(untargeted_bgsub[frame <= n_pre], na.rm = TRUE),
    targeted_norm       = targeted_bgsub   / targeted_pre_mean,
    untargeted_norm     = untargeted_bgsub / untargeted_pre_mean
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

head(frap_data)
```

## Normalize targeted to untargeted

```{r normalize-targeted-to-untargeted}
frap_data <- frap_data %>%
  mutate(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted = targeted_norm / untargeted_norm)

head(frap_data)
```

### Shift curves to the first post-bleach measurement

```{r normalize-to-first-postbleach}
frap_data <- frap_data %>%
  group_by(roi_id) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_first_postbleach = ratio_targeted_to_untargeted[frame == n_pre + 1],
    ratio_norm_postbleach1 = ratio_targeted_to_untargeted / ratio_first_postbleach
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### Plot: targeted / untargeted ratio (normalized to pre-bleach), by cell line

All regions from all files belonging to a cell line are overlaid in a
single plot (faceted by channel), colored by that region's pre-bleach
`targeted` intensity.

```{r plot-ratio-by-cell-line-prebleach, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
for (cl in unique(frap_data$cell_line)) {

  p <- frap_data %>%
    filter(cell_line == cl) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = ratio_targeted_to_untargeted,
               group = roi_id, color = targeted_pre_mean)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = bleach_time, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70") +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 0.8) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Pre-bleach\nintensity") +
    facet_wrap(~ channel, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Cell line:", cl, "- targeted/untargeted, normalized to pre-bleach"),
      x = "Time (s)", y = "Targeted / Untargeted\n(relative to pre-bleach average)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)
}
```

### Plot: targeted / untargeted ratio (normalized to first post-bleach frame), by cell line

```{r plot-ratio-by-cell-line, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
for (cl in unique(frap_data$cell_line)) {

  p <- frap_data %>%
    filter(cell_line == cl) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = ratio_norm_postbleach1,
               group = roi_id, color = targeted_pre_mean)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = bleach_time, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70") +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point(size = 0.8) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Pre-bleach\nintensity") +
    facet_wrap(~ channel, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Cell line:", cl, "- targeted/untargeted, normalized to first post-bleach frame"),
      x = "Time (s)", y = "Targeted / Untargeted\n(relative to first post-bleach frame)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)
}
```

## Average curves by cell line (across all regions from all files)

Every region, from every file, belonging to a cell line is pooled together
here — so a file contributing 7 targeted/untargeted region pairs
contributes 7 curves to the average, not just 1. We group by `cell_line`,
`channel`, and `frame`, and compute the mean and SD of the (pre-bleach
normalized) targeted/untargeted ratio at each time point.

```{r summarize-by-cell-line}
frap_summary <- frap_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted)) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, channel, frame) %>%
  summarize(
    time       = first(time),
    n_regions  = n(),
    mean_ratio = mean(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ratio   = sd(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

head(frap_summary)
```

```{r plot-average-by-cell-line, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
for (cl in unique(frap_summary$cell_line)) {

  p <- frap_summary %>%
    filter(cell_line == cl) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = mean_ratio)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = bleach_time, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70") +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = mean_ratio - sd_ratio, ymax = mean_ratio + sd_ratio),
      alpha = 0.2, fill = "#2C7FB8"
    ) +
    geom_line(color = "#2C7FB8", linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ channel, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Cell line:", cl),
      subtitle = "Mean targeted/untargeted ratio ± 1 SD, pooled across all regions and files",
      x = "Time (s)", y = "Targeted / Untargeted"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)
}
```

## Average curves by cell line, split by pre-bleach intensity tertile

For each cell line (and channel), regions are split into thirds based on
their `targeted_pre_mean` (average pre-bleach intensity): the third with
the lowest pre-bleach intensity, the middle third, and the third with the
highest pre-bleach intensity. `ntile()` is used to divide regions into
three groups as evenly as possible, ranked by `targeted_pre_mean`. The
split is done separately per `channel`, since the two channels typically
have very different intensity scales.

```{r summarize-by-cell-line-tertile}
prebleach_tertiles <- frap_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted)) %>%
  distinct(cell_line, channel, roi_id, targeted_pre_mean) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, channel) %>%
  mutate(
    prebleach_tertile = ntile(targeted_pre_mean, 3),
    prebleach_group   = factor(
      prebleach_tertile,
      levels = 1:3,
      labels = c("Low pre-bleach", "Medium pre-bleach", "High pre-bleach")
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(cell_line, channel, roi_id, prebleach_group)

frap_data_tertile <- frap_data %>%
  left_join(prebleach_tertiles, by = c("cell_line", "channel", "roi_id"))

frap_summary_tertile <- frap_data_tertile %>%
  filter(!is.na(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted), !is.na(prebleach_group)) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, channel, prebleach_group, frame) %>%
  summarize(
    time       = first(time),
    n_regions  = n(),
    mean_ratio = mean(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ratio   = sd(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

# how many regions ended up in each tertile, per cell line/channel
prebleach_tertiles %>%
  count(cell_line, channel, prebleach_group)
```

```{r plot-average-by-cell-line-tertile, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
tertile_colors <- c(
  "Low pre-bleach"    = "#3182BD",
  "Medium pre-bleach" = "#31A354",
  "High pre-bleach"   = "#DE2D26"
)

for (cl in unique(frap_summary_tertile$cell_line)) {

  p <- frap_summary_tertile %>%
    filter(cell_line == cl) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = mean_ratio,
               color = prebleach_group, fill = prebleach_group)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = bleach_time, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70") +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = mean_ratio - sd_ratio, ymax = mean_ratio + sd_ratio),
      alpha = 0.15, color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = tertile_colors, name = "Pre-bleach\nintensity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = tertile_colors, guide = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~ channel, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Cell line:", cl, "- split by pre-bleach intensity tertile"),
      subtitle = "Mean targeted/untargeted ratio ± 1 SD; regions split into thirds by pre-bleach intensity",
      x = "Time (s)", y = "Targeted / Untargeted"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)
}
```

### Tertile average curves, normalized to the first post-bleach frame

Same tertile grouping as above, but each curve is additionally shifted so
it starts at 1 on the first post-bleach frame (using `ratio_norm_postbleach1`,
computed earlier), making it easier to compare recovery kinetics across
tertiles independent of any small differences right at the pre-bleach
baseline.

```{r summarize-by-cell-line-tertile-postbleach}
frap_summary_tertile_postbleach <- frap_data_tertile %>%
  filter(!is.na(ratio_norm_postbleach1), !is.na(prebleach_group)) %>%
  group_by(cell_line, channel, prebleach_group, frame) %>%
  summarize(
    time       = first(time),
    n_regions  = n(),
    mean_ratio = mean(ratio_norm_postbleach1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ratio   = sd(ratio_norm_postbleach1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

head(frap_summary_tertile_postbleach)
```

```{r plot-average-by-cell-line-tertile-postbleach, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
for (cl in unique(frap_summary_tertile_postbleach$cell_line)) {

  p <- frap_summary_tertile_postbleach %>%
    filter(cell_line == cl) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time, y = mean_ratio,
               color = prebleach_group, fill = prebleach_group)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = bleach_time, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70") +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = mean_ratio - sd_ratio, ymax = mean_ratio + sd_ratio),
      alpha = 0.15, color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = tertile_colors, name = "Pre-bleach\nintensity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = tertile_colors, guide = "none") +
    facet_wrap(~ channel, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Cell line:", cl, "- split by pre-bleach intensity tertile"),
      subtitle = "Mean targeted/untargeted ratio ± 1 SD, normalized to first post-bleach frame",
      x = "Time (s)", y = "Targeted / Untargeted\n(relative to first post-bleach frame)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  print(p)
}
```

## Export curves

Two sets of csv files are written, both tagged with `replicate_label` so
they can be told apart when combined with other replicates in the
companion "compare replicates" script:

1. **Average curves** — one row per cell line/channel/frame, with the mean,
   SD, and number of regions contributing.
2. **Individual curves** — one row per cell line/channel/region/frame, i.e.
   every region's curve kept separately (not averaged), for cases where
   you want to inspect, re-analyze, or re-average the raw per-region data
   later.

### Average curves

```{r export-average-curves}
dir.create(export_folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

frap_summary_export <- frap_summary %>%
  mutate(replicate = replicate_label) %>%
  select(replicate, cell_line, channel, frame, time, n_regions, mean_ratio, sd_ratio)

for (cl in unique(frap_summary_export$cell_line)) {
  out_file <- file.path(
    export_folder,
    paste0(cl, "_", replicate_label, "_mean_curve.csv")
  )

  frap_summary_export %>%
    filter(cell_line == cl) %>%
    write_csv(out_file)
}

# list what was written, for confirmation
list.files(export_folder, pattern = paste0(replicate_label, "_mean_curve\\.csv$"), full.names = TRUE)
```

### Individual region curves

Each row is one region (`roi_id`), at one frame, keeping both the
pre-bleach-normalized ratio (`ratio_targeted_to_untargeted`) and the
version re-normalized to the first post-bleach frame
(`ratio_norm_postbleach1`), plus enough identifying columns (`file`,
`region`, `roi_id`) to trace each curve back to its source file/region.

```{r export-individual-curves}
frap_individual_export <- frap_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(ratio_targeted_to_untargeted)) %>%
  mutate(replicate = replicate_label) %>%
  select(replicate, cell_line, channel, file, region, roi_id, frame, time,
         targeted_pre_mean, untargeted_pre_mean,
         ratio_targeted_to_untargeted, ratio_norm_postbleach1)

for (cl in unique(frap_individual_export$cell_line)) {
  out_file <- file.path(
    export_folder,
    paste0(cl, "_", replicate_label, "_individual_curves.csv")
  )

  frap_individual_export %>%
    filter(cell_line == cl) %>%
    write_csv(out_file)
}

# list what was written, for confirmation
list.files(export_folder, pattern = paste0(replicate_label, "_individual_curves\\.csv$"), full.names = TRUE)
```
